newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NSW Australia drought area rises to 45 percent.
newsitem.headline: NSW Australia drought area rises to 45 percent.

text.p: Drought in the Australian state of New South Wales now covered 45 percent of the state, Agriculture Minister Richard Amery said on Friday.
This was a five percentage point increase over the last month, he said in a statement.
Drought-declared areas now cover most of the state's southern half but also extend into central northern regions.
The major increase in drought-declared areas was causing concern by grain producers about winter crop production, Amery recently said.
